uncertainties.note: Speaker recognizing Meio Plato (a former Giganos officer, apparently now allied with the Federation side) is not identified in the surrounding rows; left as unattributed combat chatter rather than guessing an identity.

Source uses the Neo Zeon title normally rendered 'Marshal' per character_names_021.json's Char Aznable entry ('Rank in CCA is Marshal (Supreme Commander/Leader)'); this is the first dialogue occurrence, so the choice of 'Marshal' over 'Supreme Commander' should be locked centrally. Kept distinct from the separate, unrelated title 'Colonel' (rows 11004-11021, 11033), which the source itself distinguishes later in the same mission (row 11063: 'Colonel or Marshal').

Source line reads as dialect or possibly a scan/OCR-adjacent irregularity (roughly "a timely stroke of luck, but still not enough"); translated for best-effort meaning and flagged rather than guessed into a cleaner sentence.

Bare given name in source; matched to 'Isamu' (Isamu Dyson, Macross Plus) rather than 'Isami' (Yuu Isami, Brain Powerd) because the corpus already addresses Isamu Dyson this way with the surname dropped (batch_05223, batch_05943: 'Isamu! Don't rush in!', 'Don't mind him, Isamu!').
